# TextAreaLen <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Text Areas](BlitzPlus-Text-Areas)

</div>


```blitzbasic
TextAreaLen:Int32 textarea:Int32, units:Int32=1
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `textarea` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of a text area. |
| `units` | In | Int32 | `1` | 1 counts characters, 2 counts lines. Defaults to 1. |

**Returns:** How many characters or lines the text has.

## Description

_Not documented yet._
